title: Laju
description: An internet speed test — measure download, upload, latency, and jitter right in the browser, with your IPv4 & IPv6 addresses.
description_id: Tes kecepatan internet — ukur unduh, unggah, latensi, dan jitter langsung di browser, lengkap dengan alamat IPv4 & IPv6-mu.
longDescription: Laju is a browser-based internet speed test. Measure download and upload speed, latency, and jitter, see your IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, and understand how each number is calculated — no install needed.
longDescription_id: Laju adalah tes kecepatan internet berbasis browser. Ukur kecepatan unduh dan unggah, latensi, dan jitter, lihat alamat IPv4 dan IPv6-mu, serta pahami cara tiap angka dihitung — tanpa instal.
highlights: Explains how the numbers are measured
Runs in the browser, no install

title: Neatly
description: A fast developer tool to beautify, minify, format, and convert code — JavaScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, XML and more, right in the browser.
description_id: Developer tool cepat untuk beautify, minify, format, dan convert kode — JavaScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, XML, dan lainnya, langsung di browser.
longDescription: Neatly is a free online developer toolkit to beautify (unminify), minify, format, and convert code across JavaScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, XML, and more. Paste your code or drop a file, pick a mode, and get clean, readable — or compact — output in a click.
longDescription_id: Neatly adalah toolkit developer online gratis untuk beautify (unminify), minify, format, dan convert kode di JavaScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, XML, dan lainnya. Tempel kode atau jatuhkan file, pilih mode, dan dapatkan output rapi dan mudah dibaca — atau ringkas — dalam sekali klik.
highlights: Supports JS, CSS, HTML, JSON, XML & more
Paste code or drop a file
highlights_id: Mendukung JS, CSS, HTML, JSON, XML & lainnya

title: Dibiku
description: A fast database client with a built-in SSH terminal & SQL editor. Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and SQLite from one blazing-fast app.
description_id: Database client cepat dengan terminal SSH & editor SQL bawaan. Terhubung ke MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, dan SQLite dari satu aplikasi super cepat.
longDescription: Dibiku is a fast, all-in-one database client with a built-in SSH terminal and a multi-tab SQL editor. It connects to MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and SQLite from a single app, with SSH tunnels and 36+ keyboard shortcuts for a keyboard-first workflow.
longDescription_id: Dibiku adalah database client cepat serba-satu dengan terminal SSH bawaan dan editor SQL multi-tab. Terhubung ke MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, dan SQLite dari satu aplikasi, dengan SSH tunnel dan 36+ shortcut keyboard untuk alur kerja berbasis keyboard.
highlights: Connects to MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis & SQLite
highlights_id: Terhubung ke MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis & SQLite
